mapper.select: SELECT ur.id, ur.user_id, ur.role_id, r.id AS r_id, r.code AS r_code, r.name AS r_name, r.description AS r_description, r.created_at AS r_created_at FROM pjt_user_roles ur JOIN pjt_roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.id = #{id}

SELECT ur.id, ur.user_id, ur.role_id, r.id AS r_id, r.code AS r_code, r.name AS r_name, r.description AS r_description, r.created_at AS r_created_at FROM pjt_user_roles ur JOIN pjt_roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ur.id ASC

SELECT r.id AS r_id, r.code AS r_code, r.name AS r_name, r.description AS r_description, r.created_at AS r_created_at FROM pjt_user_roles ur JOIN pjt_users u ON u.id = ur.user_id JOIN pjt_roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.email = #{email} ORDER BY r.id ASC
